basicDetails.schemeName: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Reintroduced subcomponents:Supply of Silpaulin Sheets (nos)
basicDetails.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to encourage spice growers to adopt hygienic drying practices by using Silpaulin Sheets, thereby improving the quality of spices.

schemeContent.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to encourage spice growers to adopt hygienic drying practices by using Silpaulin Sheets, thereby improving the quality of spices.
schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Reintroduced Subcomponent – Supply of Silpaulin Sheets (Nos.) is implemented by the Spices Board, India under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.The objective of the scheme is to encourage spice growers to adopt hygienic drying practices by using Silpaulin Sheets, thereby improving the quality of spices. The scheme is being implemented in accordance with the modalities and guidelines approved by the Competent Authority under the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom during the 15th Finance Commission period (2021–22 to 2025–26).
schemeContent.benefits_md: - 50 % (Gen) and 75% (SC/ST) at maximum of ₹ 2000 (Gen) and ₹ 3000/- (SC/ST), avg cost per sheet estimated at ₹ 4000/-. - Spices growers having land holdings from 0.20 to 8 ha are eligible to avail assistance.

children.text: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Reintroduced Subcomponent – Supply of Silpaulin Sheets (Nos.) is implemented by the Spices Board, India under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.The objective of the scheme is to encourage spice growers to adopt hygienic drying practices by using Silpaulin Sheets, thereby improving the quality of spices.

The scheme is being implemented in accordance with the modalities and guidelines approved by the Competent Authority under the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom during the 15th Finance Commission period (2021–22 to 2025–26).
50 % (Gen) and 75% (SC/ST) at maximum of  ₹ 2000 (Gen) and  ₹ 3000/- (SC/ST), avg cost per sheet estimated at  ₹ 4000/-.
Spices growers having land holdings from 0.20 to 8 ha are eligible to avail assistance.
Registration

ServicesPlus
website.
Step 2: Click on the “

Step 3: Fill out the registration form by entering Full Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, Password, selecting State, and Captcha.
Step 4: Review all details carefully and submit the registration form.
Step 5: An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number or email; enter the OTP and click “Verify.”
Step 6: Registration will be completed successfully, and a confirmation message will be displayed or sent via email.

Step 4: Fill in the required details in the application form.
Step 5: Submit the application.
